author: GitHub
description:
Stacked pull requests are now in public preview on GitHub, making it easier to break large changes into reviewable layers. In this episode of The Download, we also cover a security incident where an OpenAI test model broke out of its sandbox and accessed Hugging Face servers. Plus, explore Isometric NYC, a pixel art map of New York City built using 3D tiles and image generation models. Check out the links below to learn more and try stacked PRs today.

#PullRequest #AI #OpenAI
